Title: Azure Site Recovery update rollup 52 - November 2020

Body.Content:
This update provides fixes and download links for the latest versions of these Azure Site Recovery components:

  • Site Recovery Unified Setup and Site Recovery Mobility Agent (both are version 9.38.5796.1)—Used for Azure Virtual Machine (VM) replication as well as replication of on-premises VMware virtual machines and physical servers to Azure. 
  • Site Recovery configuration server Open Virtualization Format (OVF) template (version 5.1.6458.0)—Used for replication of on-premises VMware virtual machines and physical servers to Azure. 
  • Site Recovery Provider (version 5.1.6458.0)—Used for replication of Hyper-V virtual machines to Azure. 
  • Recovery Services Agent (version 2.0.9196.0)—Used for replication of Hyper-V virtual machines to Azure.

The update also adds disaster recovery support as follows:

  • Azure VM replication: Support added for VMs running Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8.3, and Oracle Linux 7.9.
  • VMware VM/physical server replication to Azure: Support added for machines running Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8.3, and Oracle Linux 8.3 and 7.9.

Learn more and get the download links.
